_what: Categories of places the reader must not read (read-data/capture-exclusion.mjs). `categories` says which are on by default; the person turns any on or off in their own `prefs`, given with each run. `seed` maps categories to domains and ships with the app; it is only a starting set. More coverage arrives as a cursor diff (action `diff`, answered as the new `state` the caller keeps): new domains with their category and `removed` domains as tombstones, so a domain reclassified or withdrawn stays gone after a later seed reload. A domain belongs to a category if it equals a listed domain or ends with `.` and one.
